 Comment React Share Leylah Fernandez tops the WTA 500 wins chart
 Leylah Fernandez makes her mark in Ningbo: her win over Aliaksandra Sasnovich makes her the winningest player at WTA 500 events this season, ahead of Mirra Andreeva and Jessica Pegula.
 Leylah Fernandez posing with the Osaka tournament trophy. © AFP Clément Gehl 21/10/2026, 14:03 1 min to read Follow us Fernandez Ningbo WTA 500 Leylah Fernandez continues to establish herself as one of the most consistent players on the tour in 2026. By defeating Aliaksandra Sasnovich at the Ningbo tournament, the Canadian earned her 15th win at a WTA 500 event this season, making her the player with the most wins in this category this year.
 According to a statistic published by OptaAce, Fernandez now leads Mirra Andreeva and Jessica Pegula, who each have 14 wins at this level of tournament.
 Remove ads Consistency that keeps proving itself
 This statistic above all highlights Fernandez's ability to string together strong performances at the mid-tier events on the calendar.
 WTA 500 tournaments are a particularly important category for players aiming for the top of the rankings, with typically demanding draws and a substantial number of points on the line.
 At Ningbo, Fernandez is therefore continuing an especially solid 2026 season. The Canadian had already won the WTA 500 event in Singapore last September, her first title in this category, after beating Talia Gibson in the final.
 With 15 WTA 500 wins to her name, she now leads two players who are regularly present in the latter stages of the biggest tournaments. It's a telling indicator of Fernandez's consistency as the season gradually winds down.
